WITH trans_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    transref,
    AVG(anlycount) as trans_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY transref
),

overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM trans_avg
),

kept_trans AS (
  SELECT ta.transref, ta.trans_avg
  FROM trans_avg ta, overall_avg oa
  WHERE ta.trans_avg > oa.overall_avg
),

kept_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as kept_avg
  FROM kept_trans
)

SELECT 
  kt.transref,
  kt.trans_avg,
  kt.trans_avg - oa.overall_avg as above_overall,
  kt.trans_avg - ka.kept_avg as above_kept
FROM kept_trans kt, overall_avg oa, kept_avg ka
ORDER BY (kt.trans_avg - ka.kept_avg) DESC
LIMIT 10
